race.comment: It was some win from EASY LOVE (3) first-up when darting back up towards the inside of them to knockoff the well-supported Scripted at Eagle Farm. That form could've just been franked in the race earlier, and the rise to the mile should suit her perfectly. Expecting her to make it two on the bounce. TWISTED QUEEN (12) held his own in his first look at the mile, but just found one ready to peak. Gets some weight relief and can hold her gloves up again, though she will need to find a touch more. DON'TCHA THINK (5) just missed the bob at the Sunny Coast last time and now gets significant weight off with the rise in grade. Already boasts a win over this track and trip and should be at peak fitness now. CARRAVILLA (2) warrants respect after digging deep under the light weight to hold off the fast-finishing Fukubana in the Lismore Cup. ALL KINDS OF FOLK (4) was only fair fresh but her Randwick win before the break still sits prominently in mind. Not forgetting.
